topics.title: Gulf tensions ripple through oil routes
topics.summary: Iranian attacks on Kuwait after U.S. strikes on Iran added pressure around the Strait of Hormuz, while regional defenses intercepted missiles and drones and diplomats urged restraint.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a faraway shipping route suddenly affected studio supplies, who would become the emergency logistics expert?

topics.title: Markets climb as bond yields ease
topics.summary: Wall Street rose as Treasury yields cooled, major tech stocks gained, and investors balanced stronger earnings against higher oil prices and Friday's U.S. jobs report.
topics.discussionPrompt: When the studio budget gets unpredictable, what expense would everyone defend first?

topics.title: Judge blocks birthright citizenship order
topics.summary: A federal judge in Maryland temporarily blocked President Trump's latest attempt to restrict birthright citizenship, citing long-standing 14th Amendment precedent while litigation continues.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a rule has been around forever, what should happen before anyone tries to rewrite it?

topics.title: Canada trade talks stay stuck
topics.summary: Canada's Mark Carney said U.S. negotiators failed to guarantee tariff stability, keeping trade talks stalled as both sides prepare for more tariff pressure.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes a deal feel trustworthy: the handshake, the details, or what happens when things get tense?

topics.title: Ukraine drones disrupt Russian summer
topics.summary: Ukraine's expanded drone campaign has disrupted Russian airports, refineries, warehouses, and daily routines, bringing more of the war's pressure onto Russian territory.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a problem that felt distant gets close, who changes their mind fastest?

topics.title: UN warns of powerful El Nino
topics.summary: The UN warned that a very strong El Nino is forming, raising risks of heat, drought, floods, food stress, and another exceptionally hot year.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the weather started changing everyone's plans, what studio routine would need the first rethink?

topics.title: Himalayan flood exposes warning gaps
topics.summary: A deadly Nepal-Tibet flood renewed attention on melting glaciers, risky development, and the need for stronger early-warning systems in vulnerable mountain communities.
topics.discussionPrompt: What kind of warning would actually make everyone in the studio stop joking and move?

topics.title: Mercury mission nears orbit
topics.summary: The European-Japanese BepiColombo spacecraft separated from its carrier and entered the final stretch toward Mercury orbit after nearly a decade in space.
topics.discussionPrompt: After a ten-year trip, what would be the first thing you'd want to look at up close?

topics.title: Gloria Steinem remembered at 92
topics.summary: Tributes from political leaders, writers, and actors honored Gloria Steinem's decades of feminist organizing, journalism, and influence on U.S. public life.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who is someone whose ideas kept changing rooms long after they left them?

topics.title: NBA penalizes Clippers heavily
topics.summary: The NBA suspended Clippers owner Steve Ballmer, fined the team, and took draft picks after a salary-cap circumvention investigation involving Kawhi Leonard.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a team bends the rules to keep a star, what penalty would actually feel fair?
